# Markus Walker

> AI engineer based in Brisbane, Australia. I deliver AI solutions from start to finish, secure by design, backed by thirteen years in IT and OT infrastructure. Looking for forward deployed engineer (FDE), AI engineer, applied AI engineer, AI solutions engineer or architect, AI security engineer and AI platform engineer roles, fully remote. Hybrid or relocation considered for an exceptional opportunity.

Current role: Senior Engineer, Secure AI. Clearance: current AGSVA Baseline, eligible for NV1 and NV2.

## What I do

- Take agentic AI from scoping with the client through architecture, build, security controls and handover.
- Build security in from the first design decision: AI threat modelling, secure software development, MCP governance, access boundaries and control assessment.
- Build knowledge bases agents can reason over, with provenance and human review over what counts as true.
- Platforms I work with include Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, MCP and n8n, with Python, TypeScript and PowerShell.
